$description: Primitive → semantic → component → state token layer model. CSS custom properties remain the runtime source; this file is the machine-readable role map enforced by _audit/ci/test-token-layers.mjs.

rules.primitive: Literal values only (hex, px, ms, font stacks). No aliases to semantic or component tokens.
rules.semantic: Role aliases that may point at primitives. Stable across themes.
rules.component: Component-scoped aliases that may point at semantic or primitive tokens.
rules.state: Interactive/state aliases (hover, focus, disabled, invalid) that may point at component or semantic tokens.
